newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-CROATIAN BARIC SIGNS AS FENERBAHCE COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIAN BARIC SIGNS AS FENERBAHCE COACH.

text.p: Croat Otto Baric has signed a one-year contract as coach of Turkish soccer club Fenerbahce, the sports daily Spor said on Monday.

Fenerbahce, Turkish champions in 1996, sacked their Yugoslav trainer Todor Veselinovic last week after they narrowly failed to win second place in the league and a berth in the European Champions' league.

Veselinovic blamed the side's lack of success on interference by Fenerbahce's technical manager and former player Ridvan Dilmen and the "alien" Brazilian system left over from coach Sebastiao Lazaroni whom Veselinovic replaced four month earlier.
Dilmen was also sacked last week.

Baric led Austrian team SV Salzburg to the final of the UEFA Cup in 1994 before joining Zagreb in 1995. Under him Zagreb finished fifth in the Croatian league and were runners-up in the Croatian Cup last season.
